summary: Security image updates install faster and on their own, a new overview of them, and failed alert mails are sent again.

new.title: Security image release overview
new.text: A new page lists each security image release for this install: when the new base image was detected, when work started, and when each update ring got it.

new.title: Security image updates arrive faster
new.text: A security update of the base image now installs within 15 minutes on its own short path, without waiting for a running update and without touching the database or settings.

new.title: Failed alert mails are sent again
new.text: A Conditional Access analyzer alert or a support notice that could not be sent is sent again on the next cycle, so none is lost.

fixes.title: Analyzer results kept for the log time
fixes.text: Conditional Access analyzer results older than the log keep time (90 days by default) are now removed every hour. Run records and the audit trail are kept.

fixes.title: Passkey summary inside your tenant
fixes.text: The passkey summary is now sent only to owners whose address is in one of your tenant's verified domains.

fixes.title: Hybrid worker folder locked down
fixes.text: The hybrid worker's folder can now be changed only by SYSTEM and administrators; an update sets this before the new worker starts.

fixes.title: Support access reads less
fixes.text: Invardia support's read access no longer includes sign-in tokens, and its settings view shows addresses and names only as set or empty.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Once a day the Overview page shows how many people are permanent members of the database admin group (never who). A break-glass policy that is off or report-only is shown as such, not as missing.
